top_left.description: A tiny crocodylomorph poking its head out of a leathery eggshell in a nest of warm sand and Paleopus herbs; it is looking up at a butterfly with wide, wondering eyes.

top_right.description: The crocodylomorph standing on a 'Chalky white' limestone rock by a stream, successfully holding a small, shimmering 3D-styled fish in its mouth; looking proud.

bottom_left.description: The crocodylomorph sprawled out on a flat, sun-warmed 'Maroon' mudstone; eyes closed tight with a tiny 'Z' bubble or just a peaceful smile.

bottom_right.description: The character sliding down a muddy 'Pale lavender' bank into a pool of water, with large, stylized water droplets flying everywhere; mouth open in a laugh.

visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC with high saturation to appeal to children.
